origin.basis: Giant Group was founded in 1972 in Taichung, Taiwan (BikeRadar).

manufacturing.basis: Giant does not state where this tire is made.

hookless_note: Giant's UK product page labels it 'Hookless compatible'; check the wheel maker's tire list and pressure limit.

availability.note: Sold by Giant's UK and US web stores; mainland China availability not verified.

name: Gavia Course 1 Tubeless
positioning: Lower-cost tubeless Gavia Course with a 60 TPI casing and R-Shield protection.
caveats: The stores offer 28 and 30 mm, but the specification lists 25 and 28 mm.
Heavy for a race tire (about 395 g at 28 mm); no independent lab test found.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Checked on 2026-11-03: keyed Xiaohongshu evidence from bounded searches (the first 16-20 result cards of each query, opened exact posts and their visible comments; not exhaustive), coded owner by owner, plus the Sigma Sports and bike-components review lists and Bicycle Rolling Resistance's test index. Counted only owners who describe their own riding of this exact model; shop and promotional posts, questions, mounting-only impressions, generic praise and reports about other models were left out.

reports.summary: Built to be ridden hard: the owner's rear lasted over 6,000 km before the tread peeled.
About 12,000 km without a puncture, though heavier than the Course 0.
Suits the owner better than a race tire: cheap and thick, only heavy.

checks.note: One owner reply plus two owners in CADEX threads; a mounting-only report and generic praise are not counted
